paras.en: When you try to be witty, you sometimes tell a little lie. I was not very honest when I told you about the lamplighters. I risk giving those who do not know our planet a false idea of it. People take up very little space on Earth. If the two billion people who live on Earth stood fairly close together, as if at a rally, they would easily fit into a public square twenty miles long and twenty miles wide. You could pack all of humanity onto the tiniest little island in the Pacific.
paras.zh: 人想说得风趣些，有时就会撒一点小谎。我跟你们说起点灯人时，就不太诚实。我可能会让那些不了解我们这颗星球的人，对它产生错误的印象。人类在地球上占的地方很少。假如地球上的二十亿居民都站着，稍稍挤紧一些，就像参加集会那样，他们就能轻轻松松地站进一个长二十英里、宽二十英里的公共广场。把全人类挤在一起，太平洋上再小的小岛也能装下。

paras.en: Grown-ups, of course, will not believe you. They imagine they take up a great deal of space. They see themselves as important as baobabs. So you will advise them to do the sums. They love figures: that will please them. But do not waste your time on this dull task. It is no use. You trust me.
paras.zh: 大人们当然不会相信你们。他们以为自己占了很大的地方。他们觉得自己像猴面包树一样重要。所以，你们就劝他们算一算吧。他们最爱数字了：这会让他们高兴的。不过，你们别把时间浪费在这种枯燥的功课上。这没有用。你们信得过我。

paras.en: So, once he was on Earth, the little prince was very surprised to see no one. He was already afraid he had come to the wrong planet when a ring the colour of the moon stirred in the sand.
paras.zh: 所以，小王子到了地球，一个人也没看见，十分惊讶。他已经开始担心自己来错了星球，就在这时，沙地里一个月亮颜色的圆环动了动。

paras.en: “Good night,” said the little prince, just in case.
paras.zh: “晚安。”小王子试探着说。

paras.en: “Good night,” said the snake.
paras.zh: “晚安。”蛇说。

paras.en: “Which planet have I landed on?” asked the little prince.
paras.zh: “我落到哪颗星球上了？”小王子问。

paras.en: “On Earth, in Africa,” replied the snake.
paras.zh: “地球，在非洲。”蛇回答。

paras.en: “Ah!… So there is no one on Earth?”
paras.zh: “啊！……那么，地球上没有人吗？”

paras.en: “This is the desert. There is no one in deserts. Earth is big,” said the snake.
paras.zh: “这里是沙漠。沙漠里没有人。地球很大。”蛇说。

paras.en: The little prince sat down on a stone and looked up at the sky:
paras.zh: 小王子在一块石头上坐下，抬眼望着天空：

paras.en: “I wonder,” he said, “if the stars are lit so that everyone can one day find their own again. Look at my planet. It is right above us... But it is so far away!”
paras.zh: “我在想，”他说，“星星被点亮，是不是为了让每个人有一天都能重新找到属于自己的那一颗。看看我的星球吧。它就在我们正上方……可它离我们多远啊！”

paras.en: “It is beautiful,” said the snake. “What have you come here to do?”
paras.zh: “它很美，”蛇说，“你来这里做什么？”

paras.en: “I am having trouble with a flower,” said the little prince.
paras.zh: “我和一朵花之间有些麻烦，”小王子说。

paras.en: “Ah!” said the snake.
paras.zh: “啊！”蛇说。

paras.en: And they fell silent.
paras.zh: 于是他们都不说话了。

paras.en: “Where are the people?” the little prince began again at last. “It is a little lonely in the desert...”
paras.zh: “人们在哪里？”小王子终于又开口了，“在沙漠里有点孤独……”

paras.en: “It is lonely among people too,” said the snake.
paras.zh: “在人群里也一样孤独，”蛇说。

paras.en: The little prince looked at him for a long time:
paras.zh: 小王子看了它很久：

paras.en: “You are a strange creature,” he said to him at last, “as thin as a finger...”
paras.zh: “你真是个奇怪的动物，”他终于对它说，“细得像一根手指……”

paras.en: “But I am more powerful than a king’s finger,” said the snake.
paras.zh: “可我比国王的一根手指更有力量，”蛇说。

paras.en: The little prince smiled:
paras.zh: 小王子微微一笑：

paras.en: “You aren't very powerful… you don't even have legs… you can't even travel…”
paras.zh: “你也没多大本事……你连腿都没有……你连旅行都办不到……”

paras.en: “I can carry you further than a ship,” said the snake.
paras.zh: “我能带你去比船能到的地方更远的地方。”蛇说。

paras.en: He coiled himself around the little prince's ankle, like a gold bracelet:
paras.zh: 它盘绕在小王子的脚踝上，像一只金手镯：

paras.en: “Anyone I touch, I return to the earth they came from,” he went on. “But you are pure, and you come from a star…”
paras.zh: “我碰到谁，就把谁送回他从中诞生的泥土里，”它又说，“可你是纯洁的，你来自一颗星星……”

paras.en: The little prince gave no reply.
paras.zh: 小王子什么也没回答。

paras.en: “I feel sorry for you, so weak on this Earth of granite. I can help you one day if you miss your planet too much. I can…”
paras.zh: “你让我怜惜，你这么弱小，却在这个花岗岩的地球上。要是哪一天，你太想念自己的星球，我可以帮你。我可以……”

paras.en: “Oh! I understand perfectly well,” said the little prince, “but why do you always speak in riddles?”
paras.zh: “哦！我已经完全明白了，”小王子说，“可你为什么总用谜语说话？”

paras.en: “I solve them all,” said the snake.
paras.zh: “所有谜语，我都解开。”蛇说。

paras.en: And they fell silent.
paras.zh: 于是，他们都不说话了。
